text:
The tool now includes Flatpak support. It detects and lists all installed Flatpak applications, as they may include proprietary software.

Updated scan results:
- 33 unofficial packages (from AUR/other sources)
- 69 Flatpak applications

To use: `./proprietary_scanner.sh`

For more accurate proprietary detection in Flatpak, you could enhance it to check app licenses via `flatpak info <app> | grep License`, but this provides a basic scan.
